_note: Exact ai-cli arguments used in round 3 (model typesafe-ai/jev, --input text, post text on stdin). One call per group per post.

args: stance=What is the author's stance on whether AI could be conscious? reject = dismisses it; curious = unsure, open or just interested; serious = treats it as a real possibility or deserving moral concern
stance._note: Round 1/2 three-way wording was not saved; this is a reconstruction used from round 3 on. Round 1/2 labels were not re-run.

args: believes=Does the author think current AI might be conscious or deserve moral consideration?
dismisses=Does the author treat AI consciousness or model welfare as a joke, delusion, or psychosis?
topic=Is this post arguing about the policy itself (rules, enforcement, company control of users, how people should treat chatbots) rather than about whether AI is conscious?

position=What is the author's position on Anthropic's usage-policy rule banning sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward Claude? support = approves of the rule; oppose = disapproves or mocks it; neutral_or_unclear = just reports it, or no clear position

reason=What is the author's main reason? oppose_absurd = it is absurd to protect software; oppose_overreach = a company should not police how paying users behave; support_model_welfare = Claude might be harmed or might matter morally; support_user_character = cruelty harms the user or society; other = none of these or no reason given
